$comment: Release-cooldown exemptions for check-lockfile-freshness.mjs. Each entry: { name, version?, reason, expires }. Expired or reason-less entries FAIL the gate (fail-closed, same contract as pqc-allowlist.json). Add an entry only for urgent fixes (e.g. a security advisory release) and let it expire. The entry may name a version: when it does, ONLY that version is exempt, and any other version of the same package must clear the cooldown normally.
